title: How Do Bikes Stay Up?
summary: A short minutephysics video explaining why bicycles stay upright. It looks at gyroscopic precession, head angle and centre of mass, and shows that bikes self-steer toward the direction they lean.
why: HN people link it as a quick, clear answer to the question of bicycle stability, including in threads on bike mathematics.

quote.text: minutephysics had a great video about this too
